quoteArray.q: Instead of worrying about what you cannot control, shift your energy to what you can create.
quoteArray.h:
“Instead of worrying about what you cannot control, shift your energy to what you can create.” —
Roy T. Bennett

quoteArray.q: Make peace with your inner turmoil.
quoteArray.h:
“Make peace with your inner turmoil.” —
Unknown

quoteArray.q: The constant assertion of belief is an indication of fear.
quoteArray.h:
“The constant assertion of belief is an indication of fear.” —
Jiddu Krishnamurti

quoteArray.q: Love doesn't need reason. It speaks from the irrational wisdom of the heart.
quoteArray.h:
“Love doesn't need reason. It speaks from the irrational wisdom of the heart.” —
Deepak Chopra

quoteArray.q: Happiness depends upon ourselves.
quoteArray.h:
“Happiness depends upon ourselves.” —
Aristotle

quoteArray.q: When you move beyond your fear, you feel free.
quoteArray.h:
“When you move beyond your fear, you feel free.” —
Spencer Johnson

quoteArray.q: Mind is the creator of everything. You should therefore guide it to create only good.
quoteArray.h:
“Mind is the creator of everything. You should therefore guide it to create only good.” —
Paramahansa Yogananda

quoteArray.q: Those who can make you believe absurdities can make you commit atrocities.
quoteArray.h:
“Those who can make you believe absurdities can make you commit atrocities. ” —
Voltaire

quoteArray.q: Action is the foundational key to all success.
quoteArray.h:
“Action is the foundational key to all success.” —
Pablo Picasso

quoteArray.q: Wishing to be friends is quick work, but friendship is a slow ripening fruit.
quoteArray.h:
“Wishing to be friends is quick work, but friendship is a slow ripening fruit.” —
Aristotle

quoteArray.q: Your work is going to fill a large part of your life, and the only way to be truly satisfied is to do what you believe is great work.
quoteArray.h:
“Your work is going to fill a large part of your life, and the only way to be truly satisfied is to do what you believe is great work. ” —
Steve Jobs

quoteArray.q: I hear and I forget. I see and I remember. I do and I understand.
quoteArray.h:
“I hear and I forget. I see and I remember. I do and I understand. ” —
Confucius

quoteArray.q: Everybody by your side ain't on your side.
quoteArray.h:
“Everybody by your side ain't on your side.” —
Steve Harvey

quoteArray.q: Never lose hope. Storms make people stronger and never last forever.
quoteArray.h:
“Never lose hope. Storms make people stronger and never last forever.” —
Roy T. Bennett

quoteArray.q: Do every act of your life as if it were your last.
quoteArray.h:
“Do every act of your life as if it were your last.” —
Marcus Aurelius

quoteArray.q: Opportunity comes when you continually push forward.
quoteArray.h:
“Opportunity comes when you continually push forward.” —
Sonia Ricotti

quoteArray.q: Anger exceeding limits causes fear and excessive kindness eliminates respect.
quoteArray.h:
“Anger exceeding limits causes fear and excessive kindness eliminates respect.” —
Euripides

quoteArray.q: If you're afraid to die, you're afraid to live. You can't have one without the other.
quoteArray.h:
“If you're afraid to die, you're afraid to live. You can't have one without the other.” —
Rita Mae Brown

quoteArray.q: Life is and will ever remain an equation incapable of solution, but it contains certain known factors.
quoteArray.h:
“Life is and will ever remain an equation incapable of solution, but it contains certain known factors. ” —
Nikola Tesla

quoteArray.q: No matter how smart we may think we are, no matter how committed we are to our truth, we can lose our way.
quoteArray.h:
“No matter how smart we may think we are, no matter how committed we are to our truth, we can lose our way.” —
Kamal Ravikant

quoteArray.q: Live and act within the limit of your knowledge and keep expanding it to the limit of your life.
quoteArray.h:
“Live and act within the limit of your knowledge and keep expanding it to the limit of your life.” —
Ayn Rand

quoteArray.q: Insanity: doing the same thing over and over again and expecting different results.
quoteArray.h:
“Insanity: doing the same thing over and over again and expecting different results.” —
Albert Einstein

quoteArray.q: Sorrow is how we learn to love.
quoteArray.h:
“Sorrow is how we learn to love.” —
Rita Mae Brown

quoteArray.q: Do not ignore the passion that burns in you. Spend time to discover your gift.
quoteArray.h:
“Do not ignore the passion that burns in you. Spend time to discover your gift.” —
Steve Harvey

quoteArray.q: When you are tough on yourself, life is going to be infinitely easier on you.
quoteArray.h:
“When you are tough on yourself, life is going to be infinitely easier on you. ” —
Zig Ziglar

quoteArray.q: Too many of us are not living our dreams because we are living our fears.
quoteArray.h:
“Too many of us are not living our dreams because we are living our fears.” —
Les Brown

quoteArray.q: Don't shortchange yourself when it comes to investing in your own better future.
quoteArray.h:
“Don't shortchange yourself when it comes to investing in your own better future.” —
Jim Rohn

quoteArray.q: You must live in the present, launch yourself on every wave, find your eternity in each moment. Fools stand on their island of opportunities and look toward another land. There is no other land; there is no other life but this.
quoteArray.h:
“You must live in the present, launch yourself on every wave, find your eternity in each moment. Fools stand on their island of opportunities and look toward another land. There is no other land; there is no other life but this.” —
Henry David Thoreau

quoteArray.q: We don't stumble accidentally into an amazing life. It takes decision, a commitment to consistently work on ourselves.
quoteArray.h:
“We don't stumble accidentally into an amazing life. It takes decision, a commitment to consistently work on ourselves.” —
Kamal Ravikant

quoteArray.q: The future belongs to those who learn more skills and combine them in creative ways.
quoteArray.h:
“The future belongs to those who learn more skills and combine them in creative ways.” —
Robert Greene

quoteArray.q: The most important thing is to enjoy your life, to be happy, it's all that matters.
quoteArray.h:
“The most important thing is to enjoy your life, to be happy, it's all that matters.” —
Audrey Hepburn

quoteArray.q: The most important battle is one to conquer yourself.
quoteArray.h:
“The most important battle is one to conquer yourself.” —
Yanni

quoteArray.q: The power of man has grown in every sphere, except over himself.
quoteArray.h:
“The power of man has grown in every sphere, except over himself.” —
Winston Churchill

quoteArray.q: Surrender to what is. Let go of what was. Have faith in what will be.
quoteArray.h:
“Surrender to what is. Let go of what was. Have faith in what will be.” —
Sonia Ricotti

quoteArray.q: He who knows, does not speak. He who speaks, does not know.
quoteArray.h:
“He who knows, does not speak. He who speaks, does not know.” —
Lao Tzu

quoteArray.q: If light is in your heart, you will find your way home.
quoteArray.h:
“If light is in your heart, you will find your way home. ” —
Rumi

quoteArray.q: Success is getting what you want... Happiness is wanting what you get.
quoteArray.h:
“Success is getting what you want... Happiness is wanting what you get.” —
Dale Carnegie

quoteArray.q: Animals don't hate, and we're supposed to be better than them.
quoteArray.h:
“Animals don't hate, and we're supposed to be better than them.” —
Elvis Presley

quoteArray.q: You must either modify your dreams or magnify your skills.
quoteArray.h:
“You must either modify your dreams or magnify your skills.” —
Jim Rohn

quoteArray.q: Freedom from desire leads to inner peace.
quoteArray.h:
“Freedom from desire leads to inner peace.” —
Lao Tzu

quoteArray.q: It is children only who enjoy the present; their elders either live on the memory of the past or the hope of the future.
quoteArray.h:
“It is children only who enjoy the present; their elders either live on the memory of the past or the hope of the future.” —
Nicolas Chamfort

quoteArray.q: I would rather be hated for who I am than loved for who I'm not.
quoteArray.h:
“I would rather be hated for who I am than loved for who I'm not. ” —
Wayne Dyer

quoteArray.q: Never let the fear of striking out keep you from playing the game.
quoteArray.h:
“Never let the fear of striking out keep you from playing the game.” —
Babe Ruth

quoteArray.q: Don't let your learning lead to knowledge. Let your learning lead to action.
quoteArray.h:
“Don't let your learning lead to knowledge. Let your learning lead to action.” —
Jim Rohn

quoteArray.q: Always dream and shoot higher than you know you can do. Do not bother just to be better than your contemporaries or predecessors. Try to be better than yourself.
quoteArray.h:
“Always dream and shoot higher than you know you can do. Do not bother just to be better than your contemporaries or predecessors. Try to be better than yourself.” —
William Faulkner

quoteArray.q: Leaders spend 5% of their time on the problem & 95% of their time on the solution. Get over it & crush it!
quoteArray.h:
“Leaders spend 5% of their time on the problem & 95% of their time on the solution. Get over it & crush it!” —
Tony Robbins

quoteArray.q: One reason so few of us achieve what we truly want is that we never direct our focus; we never concentrate our power.
quoteArray.h:
“One reason so few of us achieve what we truly want is that we never direct our focus; we never concentrate our power.” —
Tony Robbins

quoteArray.q: There are more people who wish to be loved than there are who are willing to love.
quoteArray.h:
“There are more people who wish to be loved than there are who are willing to love. ” —
Nicolas Chamfort

quoteArray.q: A liar knows that he is a liar, but one who speaks mere portions of truth in order to deceive is a craftsman of destruction.
quoteArray.h:
“A liar knows that he is a liar, but one who speaks mere portions of truth in order to deceive is a craftsman of destruction.” —
Criss Jami

quoteArray.q: Walk with those seeking truth... RUN FROM THOSE WHO THINK THEY'VE FOUND IT.
quoteArray.h:
“Walk with those seeking truth... RUN FROM THOSE WHO THINK THEY'VE FOUND IT.” —
Deepak Chopra
